correctness.rationale: Eq. (25) defines ν(U^n)=-(U^n-U^(n-1))/(k U^n) at n>=1, with special ν(U^0)=0 only. For localized central E,I source and initially empty remote E,I,Q,R, the explicit four-neighbor old-time stencil in Eq. (26) leaves all four compartments zero at a point beyond graph distance one after the first step. Hence the second-step correction must evaluate 0/0. Algebraically 1+kν=U^(n-1)/U^n has no path-independent limit at (0,0): approaching along U^(n-1)=U^n gives 1, along U^(n-1)=2U^n gives 2. Independent exact-rational stencil and ratio checks reproduced these facts. This is a failure of the PRINTED discrete map for the specified nonnegative initialization, not a claim that simulations used no hidden convention or that the continuous PDE is ill-posed.
